tweets.title: In a profound act of humanity, the family of Naib Risaldar Virender Singh ingh donated his organs following his passing in line of duty, giving a fresh lease of life to six critically ill patients across the country. The Armoured Corps JCO suffered a brain stroke while deployed at 16,000 feet in Ladakh. Despite swift aero-medical evacuation to Command Hospital, Chandimandir, he was declared brain dead on July 21. His wife, Kusum, volunteered to donate his vital organs. Through a green corridor coordinated by Military Police and civil authorities, the organs were distributed nationwide: ▪️ Lungs airlifted to KIMS Hyderabad ▪️ Liver transferred to Army Hospital (R&R), New Delhi ▪️ Kidneys & corneas allocated to CH Chandimandir and SOTTO Haryana @adgpi @NorthernComd_IA @IAF_MCC @westerncomd_IA @indiannavy @easterncomd @official_dgar @IaSouthern @HQ_IDS_India @IN_HQENC @SpokespersonMoD @IN_WNC @DefenceMinIndia @rajnathsingh @rashtrapatibhvn
tweets.content:
In a profound act of humanity, the family of Naib Risaldar Virender Singh ingh donated his organs following his passing in line of duty, giving a fresh lease of life to six critically ill patients across the country.

The Armoured Corps JCO suffered a brain stroke while deployed at 16,000 feet in Ladakh. Despite swift aero-medical evacuation to Command Hospital, Chandimandir, he was declared brain dead on July 21. His wife, Kusum, volunteered to donate his vital organs.

Through a green corridor coordinated by Military Police and civil authorities, the organs were distributed nationwide:
▪️ Lungs airlifted to KIMS Hyderabad
▪️ Liver transferred to Army Hospital (R&R), New Delhi
▪️ Kidneys & corneas allocated to CH Chandimandir and SOTTO Haryana
